5G MODEM CHAIN ONLY

Kernel/DTB prerequisite:
- mddriver
- CCCI core/fsm/platform
- CCIF or DPMAIF HIF
- CCMNI
- modem reserved-memory / clocks / regulators / SIM EINT nodes

Userspace:
1. 1nvram_daemon
2. 2ccci_fsd
3. 3ccci_mdinit
4. 3ccci_rpcd_com
5. ql_powerd.init
6. ql_ril_service
7. atcid
8. ql_netd
9. mtk_netagent
10. mipc_wan.init / netifd ql_mipc or mipc
11. mdlogger
12. scd
13. ql_ippt / ql_speed_monitor_mgr optional

WiFi7:
- OpenWrt mainline only.
- No vendor WiFi material in this package.
